features:
An upgraded version of my car script that supports more executors and is more stable and protected!

Forgot to add: make sure to wear a car accessory like this one here:
https://www.roblox.com/catalog/17681615661/Car1-Driver

V3 RELEASE, NOW INCLUDES HEADLIGHTS AND A SPEED TOGGLE, ALSO INCLUDES BOPPING AND SMOKE EFFECTS FOR DRIFTING. IF THIS DOES WELL I WILL KEEP UPGRADING IT LIKE BETTER BUTTONS, MOTORBIKE SUPPORT, BOAT SUPPORT, PLANE SUPPORT AND MORE.

FORGOT TO ADD THAT MAKING IT VISIBLE IN FIRST PERSON ONLY WORKS ON THIS ACCESSORY
https://www.roblox.com/catalog/17681615661/Car1-Driver

Changelogs: 
V3.1
Fixed R15 animation and fixed the GUI being way too big on mobile, gave it automatic scaling so it works on literally any device now.

V3.2 I havent given up on this, optimized the script by making it shorter and removing some useless lines.

V4 I added a new animation and remade the GUI.
